questions.prompt: Explain why carbon forms such a huge number of compounds.
questions.modelAnswer: Carbon has a valency of 4 (tetravalency), so each atom can bond to four other atoms, including other carbons, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen and halogens. It also shows catenation: carbon atoms link to each other in long chains, branches and rings, with single, double or triple bonds. The C–C bond is strong, so these compounds are stable.
